Resolves #21929
Related: #21358, #21140, #21890, #21312, #21835, neomjs/pages#187

Renews `examples/videoMove` (`Moving a Video`) for Engine 14 so visitors see live playback continuity across panel reparenting (`Moved to Panel B at 0:05, still playing at 0:06 (1 move)`), resolves its initial theme from `?theme=` (`Neo Dark` from the dark catalog), updates its `Workers & Platform` record `scope` + `1280 × 720` cover pair (`neomjs/pages#187`) to publish the card, and fixes `DomApiRenderer#createDomTree` so `muted: true` syncs `HTMLVideoElement.muted` on initial mount for muted autoplay.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` across `Neo Dark` and `Neo Light`, live DOM reparenting + playback readout verification, local `Workers & Platform` gallery preview with `captureExamples.mjs --record video-move` cover bytes, and two blinded swapped-order cold reads) → L3 required (ACs 1–6). Residual: Post-Merge Validation, Residual-Owner: #21140.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR-body validation, static staged checks, unit, and e2e specs ran.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Engine `HTMLMediaElement.muted` sync on mount (`src/vdom/domConstants.mjs`, `src/main/render/DomApiRenderer.mjs`):** `src/component/Video.mjs` and `examples/component/video` remain untouched. Enabling `autoPlay: true` on `Neo.component.Video` exposed a `DomApiRenderer#createDomTree` gap: setting `muted` as a DOM attribute updates `defaultMuted` only and leaves `domNode.muted === false`, causing browsers' autoplay policy to block muted `<video>` playback on initial mount. Adding `'autoplay'`, `'controls'`, `'loop'`, and `'muted'` to `voidAttributes` and syncing `domNode.muted = enabled` on mount restores muted autoplay engine-wide, pinned by red-on-`dev` unit spec `test/playwright/unit/main/DomApiRendererMediaMuted.spec.mjs`.
- **Light cover partner & `seo.json`:** Ships `video-move-14-light.jpg` (`hasLightCover: true`) in `neomjs/pages#187` and leaves `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` untouched per `buildScripts/README.md` (`prepare.mjs` regenerates it at the cut).

Frame critique: on `dev`, `examples/videoMove` opened on a bright unstyled light canvas with two `300 px` boxes, a paused muted frame (`DomApiRenderer` left `video.muted === false`), no action cue, no playback readout, and `390 × 844` clipped Panel B horizontally (`Workers & Platform` showed only 3 cards). After the initial cold-look pass flagged (1) a faint dashed receiver border bleeding behind the occupied `<video>`, (2) a single-word widow (`"position."`) on the subtitle at `960 × 540`, and (3) no starting timestamp on the initial readout, all three were resolved in the frames above (`&:empty` scopes the dashed receiver border to the empty panel, tightened copy fits cleanly, and the initial readout states `Playing in Panel A from 0:04 — press Move Video to watch playback continue uninterrupted.`). Follow-up commit `1f3c34d076` adds `background: transparent` on `.video-wrapper` so `Neo Light` paints uniform `#fafafa` behind and below both cards without `.neo-container`'s `#ffffff` slab (`neomjs/pages#187` review).

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: The parser initializes `HTMLMediaElement#muted` from the content attribute, while `createElement` plus `toggleAttribute` updates only `defaultMuted`. A DOM-API renderer therefore has to assign the live property, and Chromium's muted-autoplay policy reads it.
